brief: Content production before vs after AI — one writer ships 30 pieces a week.

slots.title: Stop doing
slots.description: One writer now ships 30 AI-assisted pieces every week without burning out.

slots.title: Research kills
slots.description: Writers spend hours browsing sources instead of drafting actual content that converts readers.
slots.badText: Manually open 20 tabs and read for three hours to find one angle.
slots.goodText: AI scans hundreds of sources and delivers a brief in 60 seconds.

slots.title: Outlines take
slots.description: Blank-page syndrome delays every post. AI builds structure so you start with momentum.
slots.badText: Stare at a blank doc for an hour trying to map sections and headers.
slots.goodText: Generate a full outline with hooks and takeaways in one click.

slots.title: First drafts
slots.description: Turn bullet points into publish-ready prose without sacrificing your unique voice.
slots.badText: Type every sentence from scratch and fight through writer's block all morning.
slots.goodText: Drop a brief into AI and get a clean draft that sounds like you.

slots.title: Edit without
slots.description: Polish faster when AI handles grammar, tone, and formatting checks instantly.
slots.badText: Read every paragraph aloud and fix comma splices for two hours straight.
slots.goodText: Run an AI editor that catches errors and tightens copy in seconds.

slots.title: Design delays
slots.description: Skip the back-and-forth with designers. Auto-generate images and layouts on demand.
slots.badText: Request creative assets and wait three days for a simple blog header.
slots.goodText: Create custom featured images and carousels with AI design tools.

slots.title: Ship more
slots.description: Schedule and distribute across channels without copying and pasting into ten tabs.
slots.badText: Copy-paste into five platforms and manually format each post differently.
slots.goodText: One click publishes to every channel with perfect formatting intact.

slots.body: One writer. Thirty pieces a week. Zero burnout. Start building your AI content stack today.
